checks.claim: TAE is the appropriate annualized cost metric used to compare credit offers and includes the components required by transparency rules
Banking contracts must state nominal interest and TAE or equivalent effective annual cost information clearly
CIRBE records loans, credits, guarantees and other risks reported by financial institutions
CIRBE is not a default/morosity register and the data are confidential although the data subject may access their own report
Financial institutions use CIR information to assess indebtedness when studying credit operations
Credit-offer comparison must not rely only on nominal interest; linked products, fees, costs and total cost must be considered

domain_specific_gates: bank-specific criteria require dated source and confidence state
verbal experience must not be promoted to universal banking rule
TIN, TAE, fees, linked products, insurance and total cost must be normalized before comparing offers
CIRBE findings require client clarification and recalculation, not inference of fraud
legal, fiscal, AML and notarial implications route to the corresponding advisory domains
limitations: This validates the repository as a maintained decision-support knowledge source, not every bank's current underwriting policy.
Bank criteria, pricing, campaigns, LTV limits, linked products and approval appetite are dynamic and must be checked live.
No recommendation may be promoted from historical or verbal bank criteria without dated evidence and confidence metadata.
